framing: in simulation, N synthetic shoppers per archetype, under the labelled assumptions in design.assumptions

decomposition_v3.reading: At visit 3 both arms share memory and every draw, and Jev's state does not depend on the route (basket_so_far stays empty on the jev path of run.py), so with route_card_logit=0 any v3 difference can only come from WHICH units are walked: the lift is the routing assumption (p_search_moved). Visit 4 also differs through memory (memory line + repaired route).

next_basket.targets: visit v+1 basket from visits 1..v (control path for v3, v4); shoppers with an empty target basket are skipped
next_basket.universe: SKUs on the shelf at the target visit (new SKUs only from v3)
next_basket.posterior: non-sensitive shoppers: 9-lens NB posterior from baskets; sensitive shoppers: declared lens
next_basket.ours_definition: lambda * personal frequency + (1-lambda) * posterior popularity / max(posterior popularity)

control_equals_card_world_for_noncomplie.how: the realised card world takes the control potential outcome for non-compliers

v3_shared_slots_identical_across_arms.why: common random numbers: draw keys never include the arm
